name: Mill certificate — EN 10204 3.1, carbon steel, BF-BOF residual profile
why: Annex VI defaults are differentiated by production route, so a wrong route hint produces a wrong emissions figure. This pins the working branch of the route inference — high phosphorus and sulphur with low chromium reads as virgin iron (BF_BOF) — and the RISKS.md N8 fix to heat_number, which used to capture the literal word 'number' because the regex alternation listed 'heat' before 'heat no.' and Python takes the first branch that matches.
